# HappyRoam Thailand

> HappyRoam (https://happyroam.travel) is a Thailand-only travel guide and planner: 400+ places, festivals and UNESCO heritage sites, visa and arrival-card help, onward tickets, safety and medical information, plus AI tools for itineraries, packing and travel questions. Most of it is free; Pro ($10/month, 7-day free trial) unlocks unlimited AI use. Made by Dizid (https://dizid.com).

## Visa and entry
- [Visa wizard](https://happyroam.travel/visa): find the right Thailand visa (visa exemption, tourist, DTV digital nomad, retirement, Elite) with requirements and timelines.
- [TDAC guide](https://happyroam.travel/tdac): how to fill in the Thailand Digital Arrival Card, the online form that replaced the paper TM6; submit within 72 hours before arrival at tdac.immigration.go.th.
- [90-day reporting](https://happyroam.travel/90-day): the TM47 report for long stays, deadlines, online reporting and immigration offices.
- [Visa countdown](https://happyroam.travel/visa-countdown): track your permitted stay and reporting dates.
- [Onward ticket](https://happyroam.travel/onward-ticket): a verified onward flight reservation (real airline PNR) as proof of onward travel for airlines and Thai immigration. $12 service fee per booking; Pro includes 2 bookings a month.

## Places and culture
- [Attractions](https://happyroam.travel/attractions): 400+ beaches, temples, islands and hidden gems, each with tips on timing, transport, costs and crowds. URL pattern: /attractions/<slug>.
- [Festivals](https://happyroam.travel/festivals): 50+ Thai festivals (Songkran, Loy Krathong, Yi Peng and more) with dates, locations and crowd levels. URL pattern: /festivals/<slug>.
- [Heritage](https://happyroam.travel/heritage): UNESCO World Heritage sites and historical parks such as Ayutthaya and Sukhothai. URL pattern: /heritage/<slug>.
- [Travel guides](https://happyroam.travel/guides): long-form guides, e.g. [first time in Thailand](https://happyroam.travel/guides/first-time-thailand), [best time to visit](https://happyroam.travel/guides/best-time-to-visit), [budget](https://happyroam.travel/guides/thailand-budget-guide), [island hopping](https://happyroam.travel/guides/island-hopping-guide), [digital nomads](https://happyroam.travel/guides/digital-nomad-thailand), plus Bangkok, Chiang Mai and Phuket neighbourhood guides.
- [Thai phrasebook](https://happyroam.travel/phrasebook): 200+ phrases with Thai script, phonetics and audio.

## Practical and safety
- [Cost calculator](https://happyroam.travel/cost-calculator): monthly cost of living by city and lifestyle (budget, mid-range, luxury).
- [Safety](https://happyroam.travel/safety), [travel tips and warnings](https://happyroam.travel/warnings) (scams, customs, etiquette), [medical](https://happyroam.travel/medical) (17 vetted hospitals) and [emergency contacts](https://happyroam.travel/emergency) (Tourist Police 1155, ambulance 1669, embassies).
- [Setup guide](https://happyroam.travel/setup-guide): SIM cards, banking, transport apps and settling in.

## AI tools
- [AI trip planner](https://happyroam.travel/ai-trip-planner-app-thailand): multi-day itineraries with a budget, exportable to calendar (ICS) and PDF; AI packing lists based on weather and activities; Smart Match ranks places by your travel style; AI chat for travel questions.
- Free accounts get 1 AI use per day per feature. Pro ($10/month after a 7-day free trial, cancel anytime) removes the limits and adds the itinerary planner, packing lists, saved favourites, a travel alerts dashboard and detailed cost breakdowns.
